name: Quin Silver
source:
The leader of the White Territory and the Pope of the religious organization. He seems to be some kind of clergyman. Although he rules his territory in the name of his religious organization, in reality this “organization” is not much different from a mafia. As the type of person to proactively initiate social events with conspiracies behind them, he is the exact opposite of [url=/c84840]“Lion”[/url]. Although it seems that he and Lion are rivals, he doesn’t dislike the tactless and awkward Lion. On the contrary, he doesn’t seem to find [url=/c776]Blood Dupre[/url], who is similar to himself in personality, that likeable.

[Taken from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/otomegames/comments/ht6694/spade_no_kuni_no_alice_character_profiles/fyfl282/]Reddit[/url]]
